claim.scope_statement: Kadiri’s July2011 version proves, for sufficiently large absolute discriminant d_K, an explicit zero-free region at |t|>=1 and an explicit strip at |t|<=1 containing at most one zero, necessarily real and simple. This is unconditional exclusion near Re(s)=1, not the critical-line assertion.
